## Validation Summary

**Overall Status**: Not ready - critical issues found

**Blockers for Implementation**: 2 critical
1. CompleteTodoItem.todoId has no traceable source (no read model feeds its screen)
2. No Role Catalog / actor attribution for any command

**Recommended Fixes**:
1. Add a minimal read model of open todos feeding the Complete Todo Item screen
2. Define a Role Catalog and attribute AddTodoItem/CompleteTodoItem to specific roles
3. Elaborate Given/When/Then scenarios for both commands (happy path + error cases)

**What checks out**: naming conventions (verb-present commands, past-tense events), command to event mapping, event immutability, TodoListView is deterministically derivable from TodoItemAdded/TodoItemCompleted, slices correctly scoped to one element each.

**Ready for Code Generation**: No, after implementing the recommended fixes above.
